title: Studio: customize a read-only package's flow into <base>.custom under its own name — one ledger switch, the declaration's badge, "Restore package original"
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ④ child of epic #28236 (P2, cut 2026-11-01 on the maintainer's 「四项提速措施全部按推荐执行」, schedule reviewed) · plan of record: ADR-0146 Rollout P2 "N-18 customize a flow (after N-12)"; schedule review correction 5 adds N-13 and N-17. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #28412, #28407, #28562

Part of #28236 (P2, child **N-18**) · governs: ADR-0146 D9 items 1–3 (the console half), D4 (the ledger switch stays on the item), D2 (badge, revert) · lane: `domain:ui` · size: M.

**Business reason.** An admin wants HotCRM's "notify owner" flow to also email the manager. Today the only path is Setup's clone, and then both copies run. With this card they press Customize on the flow in Studio. Their version, in `hotcrm.custom`, replaces HotCRM's under the same name and the same on/off switch. "Restore package original" brings HotCRM's flow back.

**Measured (`35b178bd0a`).**
- `AutomationsPillar` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:8672`), on a read-only package:
  - `ledgerRow` (:9219) binds `FlowLedgerSwitch` (:9345) to `GET /automation/_status`, pre-judged by `setup/packagedFlowLedger.ts:102#useFlowLedgerWalledReadOnly`;
  - the definition switch draws locked;
  - `FlowItemMoreMenu` (Delete flow) draws only when `!readOnly` (:9725).
- Server (N-11 #28412, open): a `.custom` row declaring `overrides.package` = owner is armed over the loader's body in one reload. `packagedFlowOwner(name)` keeps answering the base, so one ledger row switches whichever body is armed. Deleting the override re-arms the base. N-09 refuses a declared `flow` override until N-11 opens it.
- Pinning (N-12 #28405, closed): a run suspended on the base finishes on the base.
- Whether the override body's own definition `status` affects arming: not verified.

**Wanted.**
1. On a read-only base's flow, **Customize this flow** in the header. It uses N-17's control and ensure path and is disabled for the same principals.
2. The first saved edit ensures the pair and writes the flow's draft into it, with:
   - the same name;
   - the `effective` body, without `_` envelope keys;
   - `overrides: { package, basedOn }`.
   The designer then edits that draft. The rest of the package stays read-only.
3. The open override keeps the ledger switch on the flow's name (one row, D9 item 3). ⛔ No definition switch is drawn for it, and Studio never writes the override's `status` to mean on or off.
4. The header carries the declaration's badge (N-17 item 4).
5. **Restore package original** in the flow's menu, for the override: confirm, discard the draft, delete the pair's row. The confirmation says HotCRM's flow runs again. Delete flow stays for a writable package's own flow.
6. Publish refusals (N-09, N-11) are shown verbatim.

**Tests.** Customize, then an edit, writes the pair draft with the declaration and creates no ledger row. The ledger switch is present on the open override and the definition switch is absent. Restore deletes the pair's row and the base reads back. A walled tenant admin sees Customize disabled. A writable package's flow keeps Delete flow and its definition switch.

**Release safety.** Safe on its own: a published override is admitted only after N-11 opens `flow` in the gate (Blocked-by #28412). Until then the draft's publish is refused verbatim and nothing arms.

**Not here.** Arming, rebinding and pinning (N-11, N-12). "New similar" (N-22). Rail marks (N-19). View, dashboard and report (N-17).

**Dedupe.** Searched `studio customize flow override`, `restore package original`: only #28412, #28149 and the epic.

Links back: #28236, #28412, #28405, #28148, ADR-0146 D2, D4, D9.
